profile.headline: Full Stack Developer at MMM Holdings LLC
profile.summary:
I has been working PHP and .NET (More .NET Lately) Developer gaining experience in very different areas like:
- Mobile apps
- API development and implementations
- Backend applications and some Frontend stuff
- Implementations of Content Management Systems like Wordpress 
- Cloud Services such as Azure and Amazon Web Services
- Implementations of 3rd Parties API like Business administrations for Facebook Account to manage publications of content and also Stripe.
- Has been able to make very complex automatics tasks for overnights procedures
- Improve my angular's skills to complely move my next frontend interfaces to this framework.

I'm pretty happy about the last years because they bring too many challenge and i really hope to face somemany new.
